query: Maine 15 din ka notice diya tha vacate karne ka as per month to month oral lease, par landlord bol raha hai ki 2 mahine ka rent katega.

model_output.summary: Aapne month-to-month oral lease ke tahat 15 din ka notice dekar ghar khali karne ki baat ki hai, lekin landlord 2 mahine ka rent katne ki baat kar raha hai. Transfer of Property Act, 1882 ke anusar, month-to-month lease ko 15 din ke notice par khatam kiya ja sakta hai.
facts_extracted: Tenancy month-to-month oral lease par thi
Aapne 15 din ka notice diya vacate karne ke liye
Landlord 2 mahine ka rent kaatna chahta hai

options.title: Discussion and Written Settlement
options.description: Landlord se baat karein aur unhe Transfer of Property Act ke 15 din ke notice rule ke baare mein yaad dilayein.
pros: Jaldi aur bina kahrche ke samadhan ho sakta hai
cons: Agar landlord nahi maane toh dikkat ho sakti hai

options.title: Contact District Legal Services Authority (DLSA)
options.description: Agar landlord bina baat ke security deposit ya extra rent roke, toh aap NALSA helpline (15100) ya local DLSA se madad le sakte hain.
pros: Muft aur kanooni salah milti hai

citations.relevance: Yeh section batata hai ki bina written contract ke month-to-month lease ko 15 din ke notice par khatam kiya ja sakta hai.

missing_info: Kya aapne koi security deposit diya tha?
Kya notice month ke end par expire ho raha hai?
